python3 -c "
import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/FUN_company_pl_actuals_dataset.csv')

# Filter for Product A and Net Revenue
product_a_revenue = df[
    (df['Product'] == 'Product A') & 
    (df['FSLine Statement L1'] == 'Net Revenue')
]

# Aggregate by Fiscal Year and Quarter
quarterly_revenue = product_a_revenue.groupby(['Fiscal Year', 'Fiscal Quarter'])['Amount in USD'].sum().reset_index()
quarterly_revenue = quarterly_revenue.sort_values(['Fiscal Year', 'Fiscal Quarter'])

print('=== Product A Quarterly Revenue ===')
print(quarterly_revenue.to_string(index=False))

# Calculate Year-over-Year growth by quarter
quarterly_revenue['Prior Year Revenue'] = quarterly_revenue.groupby('Fiscal Quarter')['Amount in USD'].shift(1)
quarterly_revenue['YoY Growth %'] = ((quarterly_revenue['Amount in USD'] - quarterly_revenue['Prior Year Revenue']) / quarterly_revenue['Prior Year Revenue'] * 100).round(2)

print('\n=== Year-over-Year Growth by Quarter ===')
growth_data = quarterly_revenue[quarterly_revenue['YoY Growth %'].notna()][['Fiscal Year', 'Fiscal Quarter', 'Amount in USD', 'YoY Growth %']]
print(growth_data.to_string(index=False))

# Find the period with highest growth
max_growth_idx = quarterly_revenue['YoY Growth %'].idxmax()
best_period = quarterly_revenue.loc[max_growth_idx]
print(f\"\n=== Best Time (Highest YoY Revenue Growth) ===\")
print(f\"Period: {best_period['Fiscal Year']} {best_period['Fiscal Quarter']}\")
print(f\"Revenue: \${best_period['Amount in USD']:,.2f}\")
print(f\"YoY Growth: {best_period['YoY Growth %']:.2f}%\")

# Also show annual growth trends
print('\n=== Annual Revenue Growth ===')
annual_revenue = product_a_revenue.groupby('Fiscal Year')['Amount in USD'].sum().reset_index()
annual_revenue['Prior Year'] = annual_revenue['Amount in USD'].shift(1)
annual_revenue['YoY Growth %'] = ((annual_revenue['Amount in USD'] - annual_revenue['Prior Year']) / annual_revenue['Prior Year'] * 100).round(2)
print(annual_revenue[['Fiscal Year', 'Amount in USD', 'YoY Growth %']].to_string(index=False))
"
